infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Sentinel-City uses your location to warn you about nearby disasters and route you to safety.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sentinel-City uses your camera so you can attach a photo as proof when you place a 911 call, helping responders verify and prioritise your emergency.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Sentinel-City uses your microphone so you can speak to the 911 operator during an emergency call.
